outcome: Backup restore --abandon-pending fails with os error 3 when its abandon record path reaches the Windows MAX_PATH
acceptance: tests/backup_restore_cli.rs a_pending_restore_is_abandoned_by_copy_without_contacting_the_target passes when the store home sits under a deep root (the failing full path was exactly 260 characters), via the same long-path handling w-19d79e06d713 applied to the staged copy, or shorter record names, with a deterministic test at that depth

Deterministic Unicode CLI/library regressions at 260 and400 UTF-16 units pass; logical successful receipts, envelope, collision, cleanup and pending-clear semantics preserved.
